info.name: Project Hub API
info.description:
End-to-end API tests for Project Hub. Run the whole collection in order: it signs in as each demo role, creates its own clearly named data, checks every rule and refusal, then archives what it created.

Choose the **Project Hub - local** or **Project Hub - AWS** environment first (on AWS, fill in the three passwords). From a terminal: `./bin/api-tests.sh` or `./bin/api-tests.sh aws`.

Reference: /api-docs.html on the site (OpenAPI 3, docs/api/openapi.yaml). Generated by postman/build_collection.py.

exec: // File downloads (the audit CSV export) are checked by their own request.

item.name: 0. Health
item.description: The API and database are up. No sign-in needed.

exec: // A short id makes this run's records unique and easy to spot ("safe to ignore").
// An employee ID that can never exist (real IDs avoid look-alikes such as 0, O, 1, I, L),
// so the failed sign-in below can never lock out a real account.
// Dates about two years ahead, so the test project never overlaps anyone's real hours.
const day = (n) => { const d = new Date(); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + n); return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10); };
